data.desc: Quanome Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: QNME) focuses on opportunities across four strategic pillars: Quantum and AI Systems; Quantum Life Sciences - Molecular Discovery; Advanced Nuclear; and Quantum-Safe Cybersecurity. The Company combines commercial initiatives with the development of a global scientific network through its Global Quantum Council and Scientific Advisory Network. XDT is Quanome's commercial AI infrastructure initiative within the Quantum and AI Systems pillar. Through XDT, Quanome is developing a managed AI computing business designed to give enterprise customers access to dedicated computing capacity for running AI applications.
